mapper.select: SELECT t.period AS period, COUNT(*) AS dispatched, SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT n.is_read THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread_count, SUM(CASE WHEN n.delivery_status IN ('FAILED','PENDING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_read THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 END, 2 ) AS read_rate FROM user_notification_inbox n JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('today', DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())), ('7d', NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), ('30d', NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') ) AS t(period, period_start) ON n.created_at >= t.period_start GROUP BY t.period

SELECT type AS type, COUNT(*) AS dispatched, SUM(CASE WHEN is_read THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_count FROM user_notification_inbox WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < #{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY type ORDER BY dispatched DESC

WITH date_series AS ( SELECT generate_series(#{from}::date, #{to}::date, '1 day'::interval)::date AS stat_date ), daily AS ( SELECT created_at::date AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS dispatched, SUM(CASE WHEN is_read THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_count FROM user_notification_inbox WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < #{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY created_at::date ) SELECT TO_CHAR(ds.stat_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stat_date, COALESCE(d.dispatched, 0) AS dispatched, COALESCE(d.read_count, 0) AS read_count FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN daily d ON ds.stat_date = d.stat_date ORDER BY ds.stat_date ASC

SELECT id AS id, user_id AS user_id, type AS type, title AS title, delivery_status AS delivery_status, created_at AS created_at FROM user_notification_inbox WHERE delivery_status IN ('FAILED','PENDING') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification_inbox WHERE delivery_status IN ('FAILED','PENDING')
